---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for embark
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve?**
A description of the use case this feature would enable, or the friction
it would remove.

**Proposed API or behavior**
If you have one in mind, sketch the API (a `#[derive(Embed)]` attribute,
a macro argument, a new feature flag, etc.). Doesn't need to be final.

**Alternatives considered**
Any workarounds you're using today, or other designs you considered.

**Additional context**
Anything else — links to similar features in
[rust-embed](https://crates.io/crates/rust-embed) or other crates, for
example.
